docs.summary: Immutable mesh data: a single shared vertex buffer with parallel attribute streams plus one or more [`SubMesh`](#api~Prowl.Clay.SubMesh)es, each with its own index range and material.
Mesh name, taken from the source file when available.
Number of vertices in [`Vertices`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Mesh~Vertices) and every parallel attribute stream.

members.name: Vertices
members.signature: public required Float3[] Vertices { get; init; }

docs.summary: Vertex positions in local mesh space.
Vertex normals, or `null` if the source did not provide them and none were generated.

Vertex tangents in the MikkTSpace convention: xyz is the tangent direction and w is the bitangent sign (+1 or -1). The bitangent is `cross(N, T) * T.w` and points along increasing V of this mesh's UVs.
Vertex colors for color channel 0, or `null` when absent.
Texture coordinate channels (UV0..UV7). Unused slots are `null`. Slot 0 is the primary UV; subsequent slots typically hold lightmap, decal, or detail UVs.
Maximum number of UV channels supported per mesh.
Per-vertex bone weights, or `null` if this mesh is not skinned.
Inverse-bind matrices, one per joint in the associated [`Skin`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Skin). Maps a vertex from mesh-local space to the joint's local space at bind time.

members.name: SubMeshes
members.signature: public required SubMesh[] SubMeshes { get; init; }

docs.summary: Morph targets (blend shapes); empty when none were authored.
Local-space axis-aligned bounding box of all vertex positions.
True when at least one [`SubMesh`](#api~Prowl.Clay.SubMesh) requires 32-bit indices to address its vertex range. Engines can use this to pick the index format when uploading.

members.name: Indices
members.signature: public required uint[] Indices { get; init; }

docs.summary: Backing index buffer shared across all sub-meshes. Each [`SubMesh`](#api~Prowl.Clay.SubMesh) reads `IndexCount` entries starting at `IndexStart`.
Returns a copy of the indices for a specific sub-mesh as 32-bit unsigned integers.
Returns a copy of the indices for a specific sub-mesh as 16-bit unsigned integers. Throws when any referenced index does not fit in 16 bits.
